question:
Identify the INCORRECLTY spelt word in the given sentence.

BBC Media has shown exponenteal growth in their revenue this year
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling should be** 'exponential'**.
 
• The word **"exponential"** means something that increases very rapidly in relation to its current value, usually at a constant rate. (घातीय)
 
 
• **Example: **The company experienced exponential growth in its customer base last year.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Revenue** (राजस्व): The income that a business or government receives regularly.

 
 
• **Example:** The government's revenue from taxes has increased this year.
 
 
 
• **Media** (मीडिया): The main means of mass communication, such as television, radio, and newspapers.
 
 
• **Example: **The media plays a crucial role in shaping public opinion.
 
 
 
• **Year** (साल): A period of 365 days (or 366 in a leap year), used for reckoning time in ordinary affairs.
 
 
• **Example:** This year has been full of unexpected events.
